name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings
description: Dev-time type-only shim for the dsh-advisor plugin repo. The real package is private (not on the npm registry) and ships from the host dsh app at runtime; this stub provides the consumed type surface only: the settings shell's SlotMap merge declaring the 'settings.section' slot (kind list / scope root), pulled into the advisor client half via a type-only import. Mirrors dsh-private commit b8343cb (2026-08-09 snapshot).
